items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

All competitors must be available to judge and scramble at this competition. Please read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewmarketSideEvents2023#27088-competitor-responsibilities).

## Nearby Competitions

This competition features "side events" and will not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. Please consider registering for [a different competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&state=present&show_registration_status=on) if this one isn't for you.

## Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Tokyo Challenge VIII 2023

venue.name: [大田区消費者生活センター](http://www.city.ota.tokyo.jp/shisetsu/seikatsu_center/index.html)

items.information:
### コンセプト
スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。

昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。
この状況を緩和するため、1種目1ラウンドのみでシリーズ大会を開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。

### WCAシリーズ大会
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

Tokyo Challenge VIII 2023(**本大会 / 以下、VIII大会**)、[Tokyo Challenge VI 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVI2023) (**以下、VI大会**)  及び[Tokyo Challenge VII 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVII2023)(**以下、VII大会**) はWCA シリーズ大会です。
VI大会、VII大会およびVIII大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。

### 競技参加者以外の来場要件
**限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。**
当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。
**未成年の競技者に対する保護者同伴は、1名とさせていただきます(無料)。18歳以上の競技者は、同伴者なしで来場いただくよう、ご協力をお願いいたします。**
もし追加で同伴者として来場する必要がある場合は、見学者としてお申し込みください。(1000円/1人)
見学者はメールより問い合わせをお願いいたします
また、会場内の人数制限のため、見学をお断りする場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。

### サポーター募集
より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。
後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。

### Concept
Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records.

In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them.
To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions in different regions at the same time.

### WCA Series Competitions
WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can** only** participate in one of them.
If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid.

Tokyo Challenge VIII 2023 **(This Competition / hereinafter referred to as Competition VIII**) ,[Tokyo Challenge VI 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVI2023) (**Competition VI**) and [Tokyo Challenge VII 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeVII2023) **(Competition VII**) are WCA series competitions.
You can participate in only one of the VI, VII, and VIII competitions.

### Requirements for non-competitors
**Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space. There are restrictions for guests and visitors**
This competition does not have on the spot registration for competitors or visitors.
**Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. We ask competitors over the age of 18 are to come without a guest.** 
If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor. (1,000 yen per visitor)
Visitors please make your inquiry by email.
Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. 

### Supporters Wanted
In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions.
We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

**Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space. There are restrictions for guests and visitors**
This competition does not have on the spot registration for competitors or visitors.
**Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. We ask competitors over the age of 18 are to come without a guest.** 
If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor. (1,000 yen per visitor)
Visitors please make your inquiry by email.
Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. 

### Supporters Wanted
In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions.
We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.name: Warsaw Cube Masters 2023
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdkJSIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2ec91b0578bf841894ad746e0643e0b8635a99e3/logo_WCM.png)

#### Warsaw Cube Masters powraca!

Zapraszamy do Warszawy zarówno starych wyjadaczy jak i nowych zawodników aby razem spędzić czas w atmosferze kostkowego święta. Poprzednia edycja zaowocowała rekordem świata w wykonaniu Macieja Czapiewskiego, mamy więc nadzieję, że i tym razem nie zabraknie znakomitych wyników i rekordów. Liczymy, że uda się nam spędzić miło czas zacieśniając stare przyjaźnie i zawiązując nowe.

Zachęcamy do przejrzenia wszystkich zakładek, znajdują się tam naprawdę przydatne informacje, a jeżeli nie wyczerpały one pytań, do kontaktu z nami za pomocą formularza dostępnego pod przyciskiem "Kontakt".

---

#### Warsaw Cube Masters returns!
We invite both old timers and new competitors to Warsaw to spend time in atmosphere of cubing festivity. Previous edition resulted in spectacular world record by Maciej Czapiewski so we hope that this time there will be a lot of great results and records as well. We also hope to nurture old cubing friendships and create some new while spending good time at the competition.

Please visit all tabs, you will be able to find there very useful informations, and if they will not answer all of your questions don't hesitate to contact us via form available under "Contact" button.
